descripcion_larga: Master the art of Jeet Kune Do in this US version. Battle through key moments from the film in a series of challenging 1v1 encounters that push the Game Gear's combat mechanics.

objetivo: Navigate the 30-floor dungeon and find the exit.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the cult classic crawler.
descripcion_larga: Dragon Crystal (Japan) is a pioneering "mystery dungeon" game for handhelds. Every time you enter, the layout changes, offering a fresh challenge as you collect armor and hatch eggs to survive the labyrinth.

objetivo: Navigate the 30-floor dungeon and find the exit.
descripcion_corta: A deep and addictive portable dungeon crawler.
descripcion_larga: Dragon Crystal brings Roguelike depth to the Game Gear. Battle through 30 randomly generated levels, managing your food supply and equipment in this atmospheric and highly replayable 8-bit RPG.

objetivo: Protect the scientists and defeat the alien invaders.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced arcade shooter for the portable era.
descripcion_larga: Dropzone delivers intense Defender-style action on the go. Maneuver your jetpack-clad hero through waves of enemies with lightning-fast scrolling and explosive 8-bit effects.

objetivo: Win the 3v3 streetball match to become the champion.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive street basketball sim.
descripcion_larga: Dunk Kids features vibrant anime-style graphics and high-energy 3v3 action. Master dunks and blocks in this fast-paced sports title that captures the urban spirit of street ball.

objetivo: Use your detachable head to defeat the Dark Demon.
descripcion_corta: An early prototype of the cult-classic platformer.
descripcion_larga: This Dynamite Headdy Prototype offers a fascinating look at the development of Treasure’s masterpiece. Experience the unique head-swapping mechanics in an early, unfinished state.

objetivo: Use your detachable head to defeat the Dark Demon.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the surreal platformer.
descripcion_larga: Dynamite Headdy (Japan) is a visual tour de force on the Game Gear. Use 17 different heads with unique powers to navigate a theatrical stage world in this creative and technically impressive 8-bit hit.

objetivo: Use your detachable head to defeat the Dark Demon.
descripcion_corta: The international release of the high-energy platformer.
descripcion_larga: Experience the chaotic brilliance of Dynamite Headdy. Featuring massive bosses and inventive level design, this version brings the "puppet-show" action to your handheld with stunning color and speed.

objetivo: Rescue Princess What's-Her-Name and defeat Psy-Crow.
descripcion_corta: A wacky and beautifully animated 8-bit conversion.
descripcion_larga: Earthworm Jim on Game Gear captures the surreal humor of the original. Use your head as a whip and blast through gross-out levels in this technically ambitious and funny portable adventure.

nombre: Ecco II - The Tides of Time (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Save the future of the ocean from the Vortex queen.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic and visually stunning aquatic sequel.
descripcion_larga: Ecco II: The Tides of Time features incredible 8-bit parallax scrolling. Swim through time and space, utilizing new transformations to solve environmental puzzles in this atmospheric masterpiece.

objetivo: Rescue your pod and stop the alien invasion.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the iconic dolphin adventure.
descripcion_larga: Ecco the Dolphin (Japan) brings the beautiful, haunting atmosphere of the sea to the Game Gear. Solve puzzles and navigate dangerous depths in this high-quality portable conversion.

objetivo: Rescue your pod and stop the alien invasion.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the aquatic classic.
descripcion_larga: Dive into a massive 8-bit ocean in the US version of Ecco the Dolphin. Master the sonar and leaping mechanics to uncover an intergalactic mystery in this challenging and artistic handheld title.

objetivo: Save the future of the ocean from the Vortex queen.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese edition of the acclaimed aquatic sequel.
descripcion_larga: Ecco the Dolphin II (Tides of Time) pushes the Game Gear's color palette to its limit. Experience a deep, narrative-driven adventure beneath the waves with improved mechanics and breathtaking visuals.

objetivo: Win the tournament on professional courses.
descripcion_corta: A refined and strategic portable golf simulation.
descripcion_larga: Ernie Els Golf offers a realistic approach to the links. Account for wind and slope as you compete in multiple modes, including match play and tournament, in this polished 8-bit sports title.

nombre: Eternal Legend - Eien no Densetsu (English v1.0)
objetivo: Seek the truth of the world and find the lost city.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the massive RPG.
descripcion_larga: Eternal Legend (English) allows Western fans to enjoy one of the system's deepest RPGs. Explore a vast world and engage in strategic turn-based combat in this epic 8-bit quest, now fully playable in English.

objetivo: Seek the truth of the world and find the lost city.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive RPG with a sprawling story.
descripcion_larga: Eternal Legend is a landmark title for the Game Gear. Featuring a detailed world map and traditional RPG mechanics, it tells an epic story of discovery and destiny with high-quality 8-bit production values.

objetivo: Knock out your opponents and win the world title.
descripcion_corta: Professional boxing with large, detailed sprites.
descripcion_larga: Evander Holyfield's Real Deal Boxing brings the ring to your handheld. Master your timing and manage your stamina in this competitive 8-bit sim that features a deep career mode and smooth animation.

objetivo: Solve puzzles and rescue the Yolkfolk in multiple games.
descripcion_corta: A three-game collection featuring the famous egg hero.
descripcion_larga: The Excellent Dizzy Collection includes Go! Dizzy Go!, Panic Dizzy, and Dizzy the Adventurer. It’s a perfect portable bundle of logic puzzles and charming platforming for the Game Gear.

objetivo: Complete dangerous sorties in enemy territory.
descripcion_corta: A technical and intense modern jet fighter sim.
descripcion_larga: F-15 Strike Eagle tasks you with piloting the world's most advanced jet. Use radar and tactical weapons to take down bogeys and ground targets in this impressive pseudo-3D flight simulation.

objetivo: Win the Formula One World Championship.
descripcion_corta: A fast and fluid F1 racing simulation.
descripcion_larga: F1 on Game Gear delivers high-speed open-wheel racing. Featuring real-world tracks and a technical pit-stop mechanic, it’s a challenging and responsive title for racing enthusiasts.

objetivo: Tag all opponents and find the exit in the maze.
descripcion_corta: A pioneering first-person "Faceball" experience.
descripcion_larga: Faceball 2000 (Japan) is a technical marvel for the 8-bit era. Navigate 3D labyrinths and hunt down "smiley" enemies in this unique and early example of the FPS genre on a handheld.

objetivo: Move the crates and reach the exit of each level.
descripcion_corta: A strategic and brain-teasing puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Factory Panic (known as Ganbare Gorubī! in Japan) challenges your logic. Help Gorby navigate through factories to feed the hungry in this charming and addictive portable puzzle-adventure.

objetivo: Solve environmental puzzles to defeat the wizard Zaks.
descripcion_corta: The ultimate portable Dizzy platforming quest.
descripcion_larga: Fantastic Dizzy features a massive world to explore. Collect items, interact with the Yolkfolk, and solve clever logic puzzles in this beautifully drawn and heartwarming 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Defeat the invaders and earn money for upgrades.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality portable entry in the Fantasy Zone series.
descripcion_larga: Fantasy Zone Gear features the iconic Opa-Opa in a vibrant and colorful shooter. Buy weapons and engines in the shop to tackle quirky bosses in this polished handheld exclusive.

objetivo: Defeat the invaders and earn money for upgrades.
descripcion_corta: Alternate version of the vibrant portable shmup.
descripcion_larga: This alternate version of Fantasy Zone Gear maintains the frantic, candy-colored action the series is known for. It remains a standout title for the Game Gear's color screen.

objetivo: Win the tournament to prove you are the best.
descripcion_corta: A technical and impressive port of the SNK hit.
descripcion_larga: Fatal Fury Special brings the heat to the Game Gear. Featuring a diverse roster and the series' signature two-plane combat system, it is one of the most competent fighters on 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Lead your national team to international glory.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese edition of the worldwide soccer hit.
descripcion_larga: FIFA International Soccer brings the pitch to your pocket. Master the isometric perspective and strategic plays in this detailed 8-bit simulation of the beautiful game.

objetivo: Lead your national team to international glory.
descripcion_corta: The definitive international version of FIFA 94.
descripcion_larga: FIFA International Soccer for Game Gear features smooth animation and a variety of modes. Experience the tension of international competition in this polished 8-bit portable sports classic.

objetivo: Win the championship in the 1996 soccer season.
descripcion_corta: The late-release update to the FIFA series.
descripcion_larga: FIFA Soccer 96 offers updated rosters and refined 8-bit gameplay. Compete for the title with improved AI and more tactical options in this comprehensive handheld soccer simulation.

objetivo: Knock out rivals to become the champion of the world.
descripcion_corta: A gritty and hard-hitting boxing simulation.
descripcion_larga: Foreman for Real features large sprites and a behind-the-back perspective. Master the art of the jab and hook in this intense sports title that emphasizes timing and ring strategy.

objetivo: Lead your team to victory in a full MLB season.
descripcion_corta: A technical baseball sim endorsed by "The Big Hurt."
descripcion_larga: Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball features realistic pitching and batting physics. With multiple modes and professional stats, it provides a deep and rewarding baseball experience for Game Gear.

objetivo: Complete your training and defeat the dark forces.
descripcion_corta: A vibrant Japanese exclusive anime-style RPG.
descripcion_larga: Fray: Shugyou Hen features high-energy combat and beautiful character portraits. Explore a fantasy world and master magical spells in this polished 8-bit adventure that pushes the Game Gear's color palette.

objetivo: Win the tour and master the professional links.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese edition of the pro-endorsed golf sim.
descripcion_larga: Fred Couples' Golf offers a deep and strategic take on the sport. Featuring realistic wind and terrain physics, it provides a high-quality 8-bit simulation for golf enthusiasts on the move.

objetivo: Win the tour and master the professional links.
descripcion_corta: A refined and strategic portable golf simulation.
descripcion_larga: Master the greens in Fred Couples' Golf. With smooth controls and detailed course layouts, this North American release is one of the most mechanically sound sports titles on the system.

objetivo: Guide the frogs home while avoiding traffic and water.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype of the arcade legend.
descripcion_larga: This Frogger Prototype is a rare look at a lost port. Experience the classic "hop-and-dodge" gameplay on the Game Gear, featuring vibrant colors and the iconic high-stakes arcade loop.

nombre: From TV Animation - Slam Dunk - Shouri e no Starting 5 (Japan)
objetivo: Lead Shohoku to victory in the tournament.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the legendary anime.
descripcion_larga: Slam Dunk: Shouri e no Starting 5 features cinematic action and RPG-style menu choices. Experience the intensity of the manga on your handheld with large, expressive character sprites.

objetivo: Engage in high-speed dogfights and destroy targets.
descripcion_corta: Intense aerial combat based on the After Burner tech.
descripcion_larga: G-LOC Air Battle delivers 360-degree dogfighting action. Use your lock-on missiles to clear the skies in this technically impressive 8-bit port that captures the speed of the arcade.

objetivo: Engage in high-speed dogfights and destroy targets.
descripcion_corta: Updated Japanese version of the jet-combat hit.
descripcion_larga: This v1.1 of G-LOC features refined controls and minor bug fixes. Experience the thrill of modern aerial warfare with smooth scaling and high-energy 8-bit sound.

objetivo: Engage in high-speed dogfights and destroy targets.
descripcion_corta: The international release of the high-speed air battle.
descripcion_larga: Pilot a fighter jet in the Western version of G-LOC. Battle through multiple missions, managing your fuel and weapons in this fast-paced and immersive handheld shooter.

objetivo: Destroy the invading Galaga forces.
descripcion_corta: A vibrant portable update of the arcade classic.
descripcion_larga: Galaga '91 (also known as Galaga 2) brings the bug-blasting action to Game Gear. Featuring new boss patterns and power-ups, it’s a perfect color conversion of the legendary shooter.

objetivo: Win big in various Japanese gambling challenges.
descripcion_corta: A colorful Japanese exclusive betting sim.
descripcion_larga: Gamble Panic features a variety of casino-style games and betting mechanics. It captures the high-energy atmosphere of Japanese arcades with bright visuals and engaging mini-games.

objetivo: Defeat quirky opponents in professional Mahjong.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the comedy manga.
descripcion_larga: Gambler Jikochuushinha offers a fun and character-driven take on Mahjong. Use strategy and luck to outplay hilarious rivals in this deep 8-bit simulation.

objetivo: Move the crates and reach the exit of each level.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Factory Panic.
descripcion_larga: Ganbare Gorby! features the character Gorby in a quest to deliver food. Solve challenging grid-based puzzles by manipulating machinery in this charming and addictive portable title.

objetivo: Battle your way through the TV world to get home.
descripcion_corta: A visually stunning adventure starring the lazy cat.
descripcion_larga: Garfield: Caught in the Act features incredible animation and varied levels based on TV genres. Use Garfield’s humor and items to navigate this high-quality 8-bit handheld quest.

objetivo: Win the tournament to prove you are the best.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of Fatal Fury Special.
descripcion_larga: Garou Densetsu Special is a masterpiece of handheld fighting. Featuring a huge roster and fluid combat mechanics, it stands as one of the best 1v1 brawlers on the Game Gear.

objetivo: Lead your team to the championship title.
descripcion_corta: A classic Namco-style portable baseball sim.
descripcion_larga: Gear Stadium offers fast-paced, arcade-style baseball action. With its cute "chibi" character sprites and simple controls, it’s one of the most accessible and fun sports games on the system.

objetivo: Lead your team to the championship title.
descripcion_corta: Updated "modern" version of the Gear Stadium hit.
descripcion_larga: Gear Stadium Heiseiban features updated rosters and refined graphics. Experience the classic baseball gameplay with a more contemporary feel in this Japanese exclusive sports title.

objetivo: Connect the gears to power the machinery.
descripcion_corta: A brain-teasing and unique physics puzzle.
descripcion_larga: Gear Works tasks you with fitting various sized gears onto a board to reach a goal. It’s a challenging logic game that requires foresight and planning, perfect for portable puzzle fans.

objetivo: Knock out rivals to become the champion.
descripcion_corta: A gritty and hard-hitting 8-bit boxing sim.
descripcion_larga: George Foreman's KO Boxing features large, detailed sprites and an intense behind-the-back perspective. Master your defense and power punches to climb the rankings and win the belt.

objetivo: Destroy the enemy fleet and the supercomputer.
descripcion_corta: A technical marvel and one of the system's best.
descripcion_larga: GG Aleste is a legendary shmup known for its blistering speed and weapon variety. Developed by Compile, it features some of the best 8-bit visuals and music ever produced for a handheld.

objetivo: Stop Noranosuke and save the neighborhood.
descripcion_corta: A colorful Japanese exclusive starring Doraemon.
descripcion_larga: GG Doraemon: Noranosuke no Yabou features the gadget-filled world of the blue cat. Use unique items to navigate levels and defeat enemies in this charming and vibrant 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Interact with Pai Chen from Virtua Fighter.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit digital portrait experience.
descripcion_larga: GG Portrait: Pai Chen allows fans to interact with the VF heroine. Featuring high-quality 8-bit art and simple mini-games, it serves as a collectible showcase for fans of the fighting series.

objetivo: Interact with Akira Yuki from Virtua Fighter.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit digital portrait experience.
descripcion_larga: GG Portrait: Yuuki Akira features the protagonist of Virtua Fighter. Explore detailed artwork and voice clips in this interesting hardware-pushing "digital merchandise" title.

nombre: GG Shinobi II, The - The Silent Fury (Japan)
objetivo: Recover the five sacred crystals to save the world.
descripcion_corta: The pinnacle of ninja action on Game Gear.
descripcion_larga: The Silent Fury (Shinobi II) features five playable ninjas, each with unique powers. Explore non-linear stages and master complex platforming in this must-play 8-bit masterpiece.

objetivo: Defeat the Neo Zeed empire and rescue the hostages.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality ninja quest for the Western market.
descripcion_larga: The GG Shinobi is a legendary handheld exclusive. Navigate through themed levels like the forest and the city, utilizing magic and stealth in this incredibly polished and atmospheric title.

objetivo: Defeat the Neo Zeed empire and rescue the hostages.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese original of the iconic ninja game.
descripcion_larga: GG Shinobi (Japan) features tight controls and a legendary soundtrack by Yuzo Koshiro. It is widely considered one of the finest games in the entire 8-bit Sega library.

objetivo: Command Godzilla and Mothra to defend Japan.
descripcion_corta: A unique blend of strategy and kaiju combat.
descripcion_larga: Godzilla: Kaijuu Daishingeki features epic monster battles. Move your units across a map and engage in 2D action segments to defeat Gigan and King Ghidorah in this impressive Japanese exclusive.

objetivo: Outpace the competition and cross the finish line.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed motorcycle racing port.
descripcion_larga: GP Rider (Japan) brings the arcade's 1v1 racing tension to the Game Gear. Featuring smooth scaling and a detailed cockpit view, it’s a technical showcase of handheld racing.

objetivo: Outpace the competition and cross the finish line.
descripcion_corta: International release of the motorcycle racer.
descripcion_larga: Compete in high-stakes bike races in GP Rider. Master the corners and manage your turbo to defeat AI rivals in this fast-paced and visually impressive 8-bit portable title.

objetivo: Use your frisbee to survive the surfing planets.
descripcion_corta: A visually stunning and quirky action adventure.
descripcion_larga: Greendog features some of the most detailed parallax scrolling on the system. Help the laid-back surfer survive dangerous levels using his trusty frisbee in this colorful and unique 8-bit quest.

objetivo: Fly through enemy territory and destroy the core.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive sci-fi military shooter.
descripcion_larga: Griffin delivers intense aerial combat with a military theme. Maneuver through waves of enemy jets and tanks in this fast-paced 8-bit shmup that rewards quick reflexes and precise shooting.

objetivo: Defeat the Empire and recover the powerful gems.
descripcion_corta: A technical masterpiece and miracle port for Game Gear.
descripcion_larga: Gunstar Heroes is an 8-bit wonder. Featuring incredible boss fights, weapon combining, and high-speed action, it brings Treasure’s legendary gameplay to the handheld with surprising fidelity and color.

objetivo: Destroy the Halley's Comet invaders.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the sci-fi shooter.
descripcion_larga: Halley Wars (Japan) delivers classic arcade-style shooting. Defend Earth from a celestial invasion across multiple space-themed stages in this fast-paced and visually clean 8-bit shmup.

objetivo: Destroy the Halley's Comet invaders.
descripcion_corta: The international release of the high-energy space shooter.
descripcion_larga: Experience the intensity of Halley Wars. Maneuver through asteroid fields and mechanical fortresses to eliminate the alien threat in this polished and challenging portable shooting classic.

objetivo: Command a team of robots in tactical combat.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive strategy game with customizable mechs.
descripcion_larga: Head Buster tasks you with managing a squad of combat robots. Buy parts, upgrade weapons, and use tactical positioning to win skirmishes in this deep and visually distinct 8-bit strategy title.

nombre: Head Buster (Japan) [En by Chris Covell v1.0]
objetivo: Command a team of robots in tactical combat.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translation of the robot strategy game.
descripcion_larga: This localized version of Head Buster allows Western players to understand the complex part-management and strategic dialogue of this unique Japanese mecha-combat simulation.

objetivo: Knock out your opponent to win the title.
descripcion_corta: A portable update of Sega's historic boxing brand.
descripcion_larga: Heavy Weight Champ features large, detailed boxers and intense 1v1 action. Master your timing and defense to climb the ranks in this high-energy 8-bit handheld sports title.

objetivo: Trap the burglars and protect your home.
descripcion_corta: A creative defensive action game based on the movie.
descripcion_larga: Home Alone tasks Kevin McCallister with setting traps to stop Harry and Marv. Collect household items to craft weapons and survive the night in this charming movie tie-in.

objetivo: Defeat rival teams in high-stakes dodgeball matches.
descripcion_corta: An intense Japanese exclusive based on the anime.
descripcion_larga: Dodge Danpei brings explosive dodgeball action to the Game Gear. Use special "flame" throws and team tactics to win the tournament in this vibrant and fast-paced sports title.

objetivo: Rescue the children from Captain Hook.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic adventure based on the Peter Pan film.
descripcion_larga: Hook features beautiful 8-bit graphics and diverse levels. Play as Peter Pan, flying and fighting through Neverland to reclaim your family in this polished and atmospheric handheld quest.

objetivo: Win the world soccer tournament across various levels.
descripcion_corta: A soccer-themed platformer based on the cartoon.
descripcion_larga: Hurricanes features the soccer stars in an adventure that blends sports and platforming. Use your ball to defeat enemies and solve puzzles in this colorful European handheld exclusive.

nombre: Hyokkori Hyoutan Jima - Hyoutan Jima no Daikoukai (Japan)
objetivo: Navigate the floating island and solve its mysteries.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the puppet show.
descripcion_larga: Hyokkori Hyoutan Jima features a unique art style and charming characters. Explore the sea and various islands in this whimsical and family-friendly 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Win the Japanese league championship.
descripcion_corta: A detailed and professional 1992 baseball sim.
descripcion_larga: Hyper Pro Yakyuu '92 offers deep rosters and realistic 8-bit baseball mechanics. Perfect your pitching and hitting to lead your team to victory in this polished Japanese sports title.

objetivo: Complete a series of wacky challenges to win.
descripcion_corta: A portable version of the iconic puzzle-arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: Ichidant~R GG features hilarious and fast-paced mini-games. Test your reflexes and logic in this vibrant Japanese exclusive that perfectly captures Sega’s quirky arcade spirit.

objetivo: Hunt Dracula and end the vampire curse.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the gothic classic Master of Darkness.
descripcion_larga: In the Wake of Vampire is Game Gear’s answer to Castlevania. Use daggers, axes, and magic to fight through 19th-century London in this atmospheric and high-quality horror-action quest.

objetivo: Survive dangerous crash tests and reach the goal.
descripcion_corta: A quirky action game based on the popular toys.
descripcion_larga: The Incredible Crash Dummies features unique physics and humor. Help Slick and Spin navigate through hazard-filled levels in this vibrant and surprisingly challenging 8-bit platformer.

objetivo: Stop the Leader and his gamma-powered army.
descripcion_corta: A powerful brawler starring Marvel’s Green Goliath.
descripcion_larga: The Incredible Hulk features large sprites and destructive gameplay. Use the Hulk’s strength to smash through walls and enemies in this visually impressive and difficult handheld action title.

nombre: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Find the Holy Grail and rescue your father.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic adventure based on the classic film.
descripcion_larga: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade features whip-cracking action and iconic locations. Solve puzzles and fight Nazis in this faithful 8-bit recreation of Indy's most famous quest.

nombre: Iron Man X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Stop the nuclear threat in a futuristic armor suit.
descripcion_corta: A high-octane comic book crossover action game.
descripcion_larga: Iron Man X-O Manowar features heavy firepower and jetpack flight. Blast through high-tech facilities and defeat massive bosses in this intense and visually busy 8-bit shooter.

objetivo: Torture each other across various cartoon levels.
descripcion_corta: A violent and humorous cartoon brawler.
descripcion_larga: The Itchy & Scratchy Game brings the "show within a show" to the Game Gear. Engage in slapstick violence and use wacky weapons in this colorful European-exclusive platformer.

objetivo: Win the J.League championship title.
descripcion_corta: A professional 1994 Japanese soccer simulation.
descripcion_larga: J.League GG Pro Striker '94 features authentic teams and fast-paced 8-bit soccer. Master the isometric field and lead your club to the top of the Japanese standings.

objetivo: Manage and play your way to the top of the J.League.
descripcion_corta: A strategic and action-oriented soccer sim.
descripcion_larga: J.League Soccer: Dream Eleven combines team management with arcade soccer action. Build your dream team and compete in the national league in this polished Japanese exclusive.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy bases and stop the organization.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic 007 adventure for the Game Gear.
descripcion_larga: James Bond 007: The Duel features gadget-based combat and explosive levels. Rescue hostages and defeat iconic villains in this polished 8-bit shooter that captures the Bond atmosphere.

objetivo: Stop the evil Dr. Maybe on the moon.
descripcion_corta: A fast and fluid underwater (and space) adventure.
descripcion_larga: James Pond 3 features the secret agent fish in a massive quest. Use your stretching abilities and gadgets to navigate through creative levels in this vibrant European platformer.

nombre: James Pond II - Codename RoboCod (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Rescue the captured penguins and stop Dr. Maybe.
descripcion_corta: A classic "stretchy" platformer with amazing 8-bit art.
descripcion_larga: James Pond II: Codename RoboCod is a handheld masterpiece. Stretch your robotic suit to reach high platforms and explore colorful, toy-themed worlds in this charming and polished quest.

objetivo: Answer sports-themed questions to win the game.
descripcion_corta: A specialized edition of the famous TV game show.
descripcion_larga: Jeopardy! Sports Edition tests your knowledge of athletic history. Compete against the computer or friends in this detailed 8-bit simulation of the iconic trivia program.

objetivo: Provide the question to the given answers.
descripcion_corta: A faithful digital version of the hit TV show.
descripcion_larga: Jeopardy! on Game Gear features thousands of clues across various categories. Perfect for on-the-go brain training, this 8-bit simulation captures all the tension of the television original.

objetivo: Lead your team to the championship with Joe Montana.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese edition of the pro-endorsed football sim.
descripcion_larga: Joe Montana's Football offers a strategic take on the gridiron. Call the plays and execute precision passes in this polished 8-bit simulation of American football.

objetivo: Lead your team to the championship with Joe Montana.
descripcion_corta: A classic and accessible 8-bit football experience.
descripcion_larga: Experience the excitement of the NFL on the go. Joe Montana's Football features smooth animation and multiple modes, providing a solid sports challenge for handheld gamers.

nombre: Journey from Darkness - Strider Returns (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Recover the secret documents and defeat the empire.
descripcion_corta: A Western-developed sequel to the Strider legend.
descripcion_larga: Journey from Darkness: Strider Returns features the iconic assassin in a new mission. Use your climbing skills and Cypher blade to battle through robotic threats in this challenging 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Bring law to the streets of Mega-City One.
descripcion_corta: A gritty and difficult shooter based on the comics.
descripcion_larga: Judge Dredd features high-tech weaponry and atmospheric 8-bit visuals. Use your Lawgiver to arrest or eliminate criminals in this intense and action-packed handheld movie tie-in.

objetivo: Guide a ball through a sliding tile maze.
descripcion_corta: A challenging and unique path-making puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Junction tests your spatial reasoning as you slide tiles to create a safe path for a moving ball. With its clean graphics and increasing difficulty, it’s a brain-teasing gem for portable puzzle fans.

objetivo: Collect gems and defeat Shere Khan to stay in the jungle.
descripcion_corta: A colorful Disney adventure with amazing animation.
descripcion_larga: The Jungle Book (Europe) brings Mowgli’s quest to your handheld. Swing on vines and throw fruit at enemies in this visually lush 8-bit platformer that captures the heart of the movie.

objetivo: Collect gems and defeat Shere Khan to stay in the jungle.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the Disney classic.
descripcion_larga: Experience the high-energy platforming of Mowgli’s adventure in the US version. Featuring smooth controls and detailed sprites, it remains one of the most polished movie tie-ins on Game Gear.

objetivo: Restore power to the park and survive the dinosaurs.
descripcion_corta: An intense and cinematic dinosaur survival game.
descripcion_larga: Jurassic Park (Europe) features impressive vehicle stages and challenging foot missions. Battle Velociraptors and the T-Rex in this action-packed 8-bit adventure through Isla Nublar.

objetivo: Restore power to the park and survive the dinosaurs.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese edition of the high-stakes dino shooter.
descripcion_larga: Experience the thrill of Jurassic Park on the go. This Japanese version highlights the system’s color depth with detailed jungle environments and massive, prehistoric boss encounters.

objetivo: Use magic to reclaim stolen items and help people.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the magical girl anime.
descripcion_larga: Kaitou Saint Tale features beautiful character art and story-driven puzzles. Play as Meimi (Saint Tail) and use your magic tricks to outsmart the police in this charming 8-bit quest.

objetivo: Win the world championship on official Kawasaki bikes.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed, technical motorcycle racing sim.
descripcion_larga: Kawasaki Superbike Challenge offers smooth scaling and realistic handling. Compete on global tracks and manage your bike's performance in this technically ambitious 8-bit portable racer.

objetivo: Defeat Onimaru and his demonic army.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the popular manga.
descripcion_larga: Kenyuu Densetsu Yaiba brings intense sword combat to the Game Gear. Use legendary blades and special moves to defeat mythical enemies in this vibrant and fast-paced 8-bit brawler.

objetivo: Win the championship in a fast-paced soccer league.
descripcion_corta: A quirky Japanese exclusive arcade soccer game.
descripcion_larga: Kick & Rush offers a fun, high-energy take on the beautiful game. With fast players and simple controls, it's designed for quick matches and portable sports fun.

objetivo: Reassemble the photograph before time runs out.
descripcion_corta: A relaxing and visual Japanese logic puzzle.
descripcion_larga: Kinetic Connection challenges your observation skills. Rotate and slide pieces to complete beautiful images in this polished and addictive 8-bit handheld puzzle game.

objetivo: Help Zenki defeat the Seeds of Possession.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the supernatural anime.
descripcion_larga: Kishin Douji Zenki features impressive combat mechanics and transformations. Battle demonic spirits and protect the world in this visually striking and intense 8-bit action game.

objetivo: Catch colored tiles and align them in rows.
descripcion_corta: The portable version of the classic arcade puzzler.
descripcion_larga: Klax is a game of logic and reflexes. Arrange tiles of the same color into horizontal, vertical, or diagonal lines in this addictive and perfectly-scaled 8-bit conversion.

objetivo: Clear the fun house of rodents by solving puzzles.
descripcion_corta: A creative Simpsons adventure focused on logic.
descripcion_larga: Krusty's Fun House tasks you with guiding rats into extermination machines. Use various items to build paths in this clever and colorful 8-bit puzzle-platformer.

objetivo: Win against Kuni-chan in various digital board games.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive featuring a popular variety star.
descripcion_larga: Kuni-chan no Game Tengoku is a vibrant collection of mini-games and board game simulations. It’s a lighthearted and fun title that showcases the Game Gear's colorful personality.

objetivo: Compete in even more wacky challenges and games.
descripcion_corta: The sequel to the Japanese variety game collection.
descripcion_larga: Kuni-chan no Game Tengoku Part 2 expands on the original with more variety and better graphics. Perfect for short bursts of play, it’s a charming piece of Japanese handheld history.

nombre: Land of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Reclaim the "Good Magic" from the Phantom Castle.
descripcion_corta: A legendary masterpiece of 8-bit level design.
descripcion_larga: Land of Illusion is one of Mickey's finest hours. Featuring creative items and stunning environments, guide Mickey through a fantasy world in this technically brilliant and charming classic.

objetivo: Fight your way through the movie world.
descripcion_corta: A gritty action game based on the Schwarzenegger film.
descripcion_larga: Last Action Hero features tough urban combat and vehicle stages. Use Danny’s movie knowledge and Jack’s brawn to defeat the villains in this atmospheric handheld brawler.

nombre: Legend of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Find the lost book and stop the evil queen.
descripcion_corta: The stunning final chapter of the Illusion trilogy.
descripcion_larga: Legend of Illusion features beautiful graphics and a focus on story and item collection. It's a technical showcase for the Game Gear and a must-play for Disney fans.

objetivo: Guide the helpless Lemmings to the exit of each level.
descripcion_corta: The definitive portable version of the puzzle hit.
descripcion_larga: Lemmings on Game Gear captures the addictive "save-them-all" gameplay perfectly. Assign skills to your lemmings to navigate deadly traps in this deep and challenging 8-bit port.

objetivo: Guide the helpless Lemmings to the exit of each level.
descripcion_corta: Beta version of the iconic portable puzzle-strategy game.
descripcion_larga: This Lemmings Beta offers a look at the early development of the handheld port. Test the interface and level physics in this rare 8-bit build of the classic PC title.

objetivo: Grow from a cub to a king and defeat Scar.
descripcion_corta: A beautiful and difficult movie tie-in.
descripcion_larga: The Lion King (Europe) features incredible animation and catchy music. Navigate the Pride Lands and survive the stampede in this visually vibrant and high-quality 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Grow from a cub to a king and defeat Scar.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Disney masterpiece.
descripcion_larga: Experience Simba's journey in the US version of The Lion King. With its challenging platforming and stunning 8-bit color, it stands as one of the best-looking games on the system.

objetivo: Infiltrate the second island and survive the dinosaurs.
descripcion_corta: A late-release Jurassic sequel with refined gameplay.
descripcion_larga: The Lost World: Jurassic Park features intense shooting and exploration. Battle rogue hunters and dangerous predators in this atmospheric and high-quality dinosaur sequel.

objetivo: Recover Scrooge's lucky dime from the evil witch.
descripcion_corta: A foundational and charming Donald Duck adventure.
descripcion_larga: The Lucky Dime Caper features excellent 8-bit graphics and tight controls. Travel the world and use your mallet or frisbee to defeat enemies in this Sega handheld classic.

objetivo: Guide your students through a magical school adventure.
descripcion_corta: A deep RPG spin-off of the legendary Lunar series.
descripcion_larga: Lunar: Sanposuru Gakuen features beautiful turn-based combat and a rich story. Explore the floating island and master magical abilities in this high-quality Japanese exclusive.

objetivo: Win the Super Bowl with updated 1995 rosters.
descripcion_corta: A detailed and professional portable NFL sim.
descripcion_larga: Madden NFL '95 brings the gridiron to your pocket. Featuring real players and team stats, it offers a deep and strategic take on American football for handheld gamers.

objetivo: Lead your team to victory in the 1996 season.
descripcion_corta: The refined and final 8-bit Madden experience.
descripcion_larga: Madden NFL '96 features updated plays and better AI. Master the play-calling and field action in this comprehensive and polished portable football simulation.

nombre: Madou Monogatari A - Doki-Doki Vacation (English - Translated)
objetivo: Help Arle pass her magical kindergarten exam.
descripcion_corta: Fan-translated version of the charming dungeon RPG.
descripcion_larga: Madou Monogatari A (English) lets Western players enjoy the prequel to Puyo Puyo. Navigate 3D dungeons and engage in cute yet challenging battles in this colorful translated quest.

objetivo: Help Arle pass her magical kindergarten exam.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive RPG with a unique combat system.
descripcion_larga: Madou Monogatari A: Doki-Doki Vacation features beautiful 8-bit art and 3D navigation. Help the young mage Arle solve puzzles and defeat monsters in this heartwarming handheld RPG.

objetivo: Conquer the three magical towers to become a mage.
descripcion_corta: The origin story of the Puyo Puyo universe.
descripcion_larga: Madou Monogatari I is a classic first-person dungeon crawler. Featuring voice clips and expressive sprites, explore dangerous towers to earn your magic license in this technical 8-bit gem.

nombre: Madou Monogatari I - Mitsu no Madouryoku (English)
objetivo: Conquer the towers and graduate from magic school.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the first Madou epic.
descripcion_larga: Madou Monogatari I (English) brings the origin of Arle Nadja to Western players. Navigate 3D labyrinths, battle quirky monsters, and experience the charming RPG roots of the Puyo Puyo universe in full English.

objetivo: Escape the ancient ruins and defeat Schezo Wegey.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated sequel starring 16-year-old Arle.
descripcion_larga: Madou Monogatari II (English) follows Arle as she is kidnapped by a dark wizard. Explore treacherous ruins and master elemental spells in this beautifully illustrated and story-rich 8-bit handheld RPG.

objetivo: Escape the ancient ruins and defeat Schezo Wegey.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of Arle’s second quest.
descripcion_larga: Madou Monogatari II: Arle 16-Sai features impressive voice clips and expressive character portraits. It’s a technical showcase for the Game Gear, blending traditional dungeon crawling with a heartwarming narrative.

nombre: Madou Monogatari III - Kyuukyoku Joou-sama (English Translated)
objetivo: Defeat the Queen and finish your magical journey.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated finale of the Game Gear trilogy.
descripcion_larga: Madou Monogatari III (English) sees Arle facing her toughest challenges yet. Use strategy and magic to navigate complex 3D dungeons in this polished and humorous 8-bit RPG, now fully accessible to English speakers.

objetivo: Defeat the Queen and finish your magical journey.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the trilogy’s conclusion.
descripcion_larga: Experience the final chapter of the Madou series on Game Gear. Madou Monogatari III features refined combat mechanics and stunning 8-bit art, solidifying its place as one of the system’s best RPG experiences.

objetivo: Defeat the Queen and finish your magical journey.
descripcion_corta: Updated Japanese version of the third Madou quest.
descripcion_larga: This v1.1 of Madou Monogatari III features minor bug fixes and balance tweaks. Explore the depths of the 3D dungeons and master Arle's magic in the most polished version of this handheld classic.

objetivo: Lead the Magic Knights to save the world of Cephiro.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the hit CLAMP anime.
descripcion_larga: Magic Knight Rayearth features beautiful cutscenes and tactical turn-based combat. Control Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu as they pilot their Rune Gods to defeat Zagato in this vibrant and story-driven 8-bit RPG.

nombre: Magic Knight Rayearth 2 - Making of Magic Knight (Japan)
objetivo: Explore the world and development of Rayearth.
descripcion_corta: A unique Japanese exclusive "making-of" title.
descripcion_larga: Magic Knight Rayearth 2: Making of Magic Knight is a fan-service treasure. It features character bios, art galleries, and mini-games that expand on the lore of the anime and the first Game Gear game.

objetivo: Rescue the princess by manipulating the environment.
descripcion_corta: A creative and charming logic-based puzzle quest.
descripcion_larga: Magical Puzzle Popils (known as Popils) is an addictive gem. Break blocks and time your movements to reunite a boy and a princess across dozens of increasingly difficult 8-bit puzzle stages.

objetivo: Use your magical powers to clear each level.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive based on the wacky anime.
descripcion_larga: Magical Taruruuto-kun features bright, colorful graphics and creative mechanics. Use Taruruuto's magic to fly and manipulate items in this charming and polished 8-bit handheld adventure.

objetivo: Lead your pro team to the championship.
descripcion_corta: A fast and accessible portable baseball simulation.
descripcion_larga: The Majors Pro Baseball brings the diamond to your pocket. Featuring a full roster of teams and smooth batting/pitching gameplay, it’s a solid and competitive sports title for Game Gear.

objetivo: Recover all stolen items while avoiding the cats.
descripcion_corta: A vibrant portable port of the Namco arcade classic.
descripcion_larga: Mappy (Japan) features the iconic police mouse in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. Bounce on trampolines and use doors to outsmart the Mewkies in this colorful and faithful 8-bit conversion.

objetivo: Guide the marble to the goal before time runs out.
descripcion_corta: A technical and challenging port of the arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: Marble Madness features impressive 8-bit physics and pseudo-3D environments. Navigate through hazard-filled courses in a test of precision and speed that shines on the handheld's color screen.

objetivo: Use your soccer ball to defeat the polluters.
descripcion_corta: A unique sports-themed action platformer.
descripcion_larga: Marko's Magic Football features incredibly smooth animation and creative gameplay. Use your ball as a weapon and a tool to solve puzzles in this polished and vibrant European-exclusive quest.

objetivo: Defeat the Robot Masters and stop Dr. Wily.
descripcion_corta: A rare and high-octane 8-bit Mega Man exclusive.
descripcion_larga: Mega Man on Game Gear is a legendary collectible. Combining levels from the NES classics, it features fast-paced shooting, iconic boss battles, and vibrant colors in one of the system's most intense action games.

objetivo: Capture and fuse monsters to save the world.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the iconic spin-off.
descripcion_larga: Megami Tensei Gaiden: Last Bible (English) brings the legendary monster-collecting series to Western fans. Recruit demons and explore a vast fantasy world in this deep and addictive handheld RPG.

objetivo: Capture and fuse monsters to save the world.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese monster-collecting adventure.
descripcion_larga: Last Bible (Japan) is a foundational entry in the Megaten franchise. Featuring a complex demon-fusion system and tactical turn-based battles, it offers hundreds of hours of 8-bit portable RPG depth.

nombre: Megami Tensei Gaiden - Last Bible S (English)
objetivo: Stop the apocalypse in a world of demons and humans.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the expanded sequel.
descripcion_larga: Last Bible S (English) lets players experience the enhanced "Special" version of the game. Featuring improved graphics and more monsters to recruit, it’s a definitive handheld RPG experience in English.

nombre: Megami Tensei Gaiden - Last Bible S (Japan)
objetivo: Stop the apocalypse in a world of demons and humans.
descripcion_corta: The enhanced Japanese "Special" monster-collecting RPG.
descripcion_larga: Last Bible S is an upgraded version featuring more detailed sprites and expanded story elements. Dive into the world of demon summoning and fusion in this high-quality 8-bit portable classic.

nombre: Mick & Mack as the Global Gladiators (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Clean up the environment and defeat the polluters.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced and visually busy action platformer.
descripcion_larga: Global Gladiators features Mick and Mack in a quest to save the Earth. Blast through vibrant, slime-filled levels with a goo-gun in this technically impressive and high-energy 8-bit handheld title.

nombre: Mickey Mouse Densetsu no Oukoku - Legend of Illusion (Japan)
objetivo: Find the lost book and stop the evil queen.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Legend of Illusion.
descripcion_larga: Mickey Mouse Densetsu no Oukoku is a masterpiece of handheld animation. Guide Mickey through a fairytale world in this visually stunning finale to the 8-bit Illusion trilogy.

objetivo: Rescue Minnie Mouse from the witch Mizrabel.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Castle of Illusion.
descripcion_larga: Mickey Mouse no Castle Illusion is one of the most beloved games on the system. Featuring creative levels and perfect controls, it is the gold standard for 8-bit Disney platforming.

nombre: Mickey Mouse no Mahou no Crystal (Japan)
objetivo: Reclaim the "Good Magic" from the Phantom Castle.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Land of Illusion.
descripcion_larga: Mickey Mouse no Mahou no Crystal features deep level design and unique power-ups. Explore a massive fantasy kingdom and help Mickey restore peace in this technical handheld marvel.

objetivo: Solve puzzles to win a chance to enter the castle.
descripcion_corta: A brain-teasing Disney quest for younger players.
descripcion_larga: Mickey's Ultimate Challenge features a variety of logic puzzles and mini-games. It’s a charming and accessible title that focuses on thinking and observation rather than high-speed action.

objetivo: Win the race across household-themed tracks.
descripcion_corta: A legendary and addictive miniature racing port.
descripcion_larga: Micro Machines brings the tiny cars to the small screen. Race across breakfast tables and bathtubs in this incredibly fun and competitive 8-bit handheld racer that rewards memorization and skill.

objetivo: Compete in the turbo tournament across new tracks.
descripcion_corta: The high-speed sequel to the miniature racing hit.
descripcion_larga: Micro Machines 2 features more vehicles, faster gameplay, and even more creative tracks. It’s the ultimate version of the series on Game Gear, offering endless portable racing fun.

nombre: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers - The Movie (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Defeat Ivan Ooze and his army to save Angel Grove.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic brawler based on the feature film.
descripcion_larga: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: The Movie features large sprites and intense martial arts action. Choose your favorite Ranger and battle through movie-inspired levels in this vibrant 8-bit title.

objetivo: Stop Rita Repulsa and her monsters from invading.
descripcion_corta: The high-energy debut of the Rangers on Game Gear.
descripcion_larga: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers features 1v1 style combat and massive Zord battles. Experience the excitement of the TV show with smooth animation and iconic 8-bit music.

objetivo: Lead your MLB team to the World Series.
descripcion_corta: A professional baseball sim with real player data.
descripcion_larga: MLBPA Baseball features officially licensed players and authentic stats. With multiple modes and realistic 8-bit mechanics, it’s a deep and rewarding baseball experience for handheld gamers.

nombre: Moldorian - Hikari to Yami no Sister (Japan)
objetivo: Save your sister and stop the darkness from rising.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive RPG with beautiful art.
descripcion_larga: Moldorian: Hikari to Yami no Sister is a hidden gem on the Game Gear. Featuring a unique overhead perspective and tactical combat, it tells a compelling fantasy story with high-quality 8-bit production values.

objetivo: Win the championship by crushing the competition.
descripcion_corta: High-octane monster truck racing and destruction.
descripcion_larga: Monster Truck Wars brings the roar of the arena to your handheld. Navigate treacherous obstacle courses and mud tracks while managing your nitro and damage in this aggressive 8-bit racing sim.

nombre: Monster World II - Dragon no Wana (Japan)
objetivo: Break the curse by defeating the Vampire Dragon.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Wonder Boy III: The Dragon's Trap.
descripcion_larga: Monster World II is a masterpiece of non-linear design. Transform into different creatures to gain new abilities and explore a massive, interconnected 8-bit world in this definitive portable classic.

objetivo: Defeat Shang Tsung and win the tournament.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the legendary arcade brawler.
descripcion_larga: Mortal Kombat (Japan) features the iconic roster and fluid 8-bit combat. Execute special moves and fatalities in this technically impressive handheld conversion that captures the arcade's dark atmosphere.

objetivo: Defeat Shang Tsung and win the tournament.
descripcion_corta: The definitive international version of the hit fighter.
descripcion_larga: Experience the blood-pumping action of Mortal Kombat on the go. This v2.6 release features refined controls and all the secret moves that made the original a global phenomenon.

objetivo: Stop Shao Kahn’s invasion of Earthrealm.
descripcion_corta: A late-release and rare 8-bit port of the third entry.
descripcion_larga: Mortal Kombat 3 is a technical achievement for Game Gear. Featuring digitized-style sprites and the new "Run" mechanic, it brings the intense kombat and new characters to the small screen.

objetivo: Defeat Shao Kahn in the Outworld tournament.
descripcion_corta: The acclaimed sequel with more fighters and secrets.
descripcion_larga: Mortal Kombat II for Game Gear features improved graphics and a larger roster, including Jax and Mileena. Master the new stages and hidden fatalities in this high-quality 8-bit brawler.

objetivo: Eat all the dots and avoid the ghosts.
descripcion_corta: A perfect portable version of the arcade queen.
descripcion_larga: Ms. Pac-Man brings the classic maze-running gameplay to Game Gear with vibrant colors. Navigate through four different maze layouts and use power pellets to turn the tables on the ghosts.

objetivo: Solve specific "mission" puzzles to clear the screen.
descripcion_corta: A puzzle-centric spin-off of the Puyo Puyo series.
descripcion_larga: Nazo Puyo (Japan) focuses on logic rather than speed. Solve over 100 "Mission" stages where you must clear specific beans under set conditions in this addictive 8-bit brain-teaser.

objetivo: Solve even more complex Puyo Puyo logic puzzles.
descripcion_corta: The expanded sequel to the Puyo mission series.
descripcion_larga: Nazo Puyo 2 (Japan) features more stages and refined puzzle mechanics. It’s a perfect "pick-up-and-play" title that rewards strategic thinking and careful placement of your Puyo beans.

objetivo: Solve Arle's puzzles to collect curry ingredients.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the Arle's Roux quest.
descripcion_larga: Nazo Puyo Arle no Roux (English) combines Puyo puzzles with a charming RPG-lite story. Help Arle find her curry ingredients by solving logic puzzles, now fully playable in English.

objetivo: Solve Arle's puzzles to collect curry ingredients.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese Puyo puzzle adventure.
descripcion_larga: Arle no Roux features beautiful character art and a whimsical story. Navigate the map and solve "Nazo" (riddle) Puyo challenges in this high-quality and colorful 8-bit handheld title.

nombre: Nazo Puyo Arle no Roux (Japan) (Development Edition)
objetivo: Solve Arle's puzzles to collect curry ingredients.
descripcion_corta: A rare development build of the Puyo puzzle quest.
descripcion_larga: This Development Edition of Arle no Roux offers a look at the game's production. It’s a fascinating piece for collectors, featuring the core puzzle mechanics and charming 8-bit visuals.

objetivo: Lead your NBA team to the playoffs.
descripcion_corta: A professional 5v5 basketball simulation.
descripcion_larga: NBA Action features officially licensed teams and players. Execute dunks, fast breaks, and strategic plays in this detailed 8-bit simulation of the professional basketball experience.

objetivo: Win at high-flying, 2v2 arcade basketball.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese edition of the explosive arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: NBA Jam brings the "He's On Fire!" excitement to your pocket. Featuring massive dunks and no-foul gameplay, it’s a high-energy 8-bit conversion of the legendary arcade sports game.

objetivo: Win at high-flying, 2v2 arcade basketball.
descripcion_corta: The definitive international version of NBA Jam.
descripcion_larga: Experience the over-the-top action of NBA Jam. Shatter backboards and perform gravity-defying moves with your favorite NBA stars in this fast-paced and addictive 8-bit classic.

objetivo: Win at high-flying, 2v2 arcade basketball.
descripcion_corta: Updated v1.1 release of the iconic basketball game.
descripcion_larga: This v1.1 of NBA Jam features minor bug fixes and roster tweaks. It remains a technical showcase for the Game Gear, delivering fluid animation and frantic sports action.

objetivo: Win the tournament with expanded rosters and moves.
descripcion_corta: The definitive update to the NBA Jam series.
descripcion_larga: NBA Jam Tournament Edition adds new players, more power-ups, and the "Hot Spots" feature. It is the ultimate version of arcade basketball for the Game Gear’s color screen.

objetivo: Take care of your cats and keep them happy.
descripcion_corta: A charming Japanese exclusive cat simulator.
descripcion_larga: Neko Daisuki! (I Love Cats!) allows you to feed, play with, and raise various breeds of cats. It’s a gentle and visually cute 8-bit title that was a precursor to modern virtual pet games.

objetivo: Win the Super Bowl with the 1995 NFL rosters.
descripcion_corta: A strategic and licensed American football sim.
descripcion_larga: NFL '95 brings the full 11-on-11 football experience to the handheld. Call plays and manage your team’s stats in this comprehensive 8-bit simulation of the NFL season.

objetivo: Master the skills of a pro quarterback.
descripcion_corta: The refined '96 edition of the football skill sim.
descripcion_larga: NFL Quarterback Club '96 features updated rosters and improved AI. Focus on precision passing and play execution in this polished and challenging 8-bit portable sports title.

objetivo: Master the skills of a pro quarterback.
descripcion_corta: A unique football game focused on QB challenges.
descripcion_larga: NFL Quarterback Club features multiple modes including season play and specialized skill challenges. Experience the pressure of the gridiron in this detailed and licensed handheld title.

objetivo: Win the Stanley Cup with NHL stars.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced and licensed ice hockey simulation.
descripcion_larga: NHL All-Star Hockey features all the teams and players from the era. Master the one-timers and defensive checks in this high-energy 8-bit conversion of the beautiful game on ice.

objetivo: Outscore the opponent in a full hockey season.
descripcion_corta: The first professional NHL game for the Game Gear.
descripcion_larga: NHL Hockey brings the intensity of the rink to the small screen. Featuring smooth skating and realistic 8-bit physics, it’s a solid and competitive sports title for hockey fans.

objetivo: Defeat the dark forces and recover the Dragon Sword.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the handheld ninja exclusive.
descripcion_larga: Ninja Gaiden (Japan) is an original 8-bit adventure. Follow Ryu Hayabusa through cinematic cutscenes and intense platforming levels that are unique to the Game Gear hardware.

objetivo: Defeat the dark forces and recover the Dragon Sword.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed, handheld-exclusive ninja masterpiece.
descripcion_larga: Ninja Gaiden for Game Gear is a must-play. Not a port of the NES game, it features unique levels, brand new bosses, and the series' signature fast-paced wall-jumping action in vibrant color.

objetivo: Win the tournament using Ninku martial arts.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive fighter based on the anime.
descripcion_larga: Ninku features a unique cast of characters with elemental powers. Experience fluid 1v1 combat and impressive 8-bit character sprites in this faithful adaptation of the popular manga.

objetivo: Travel to the Heavenly Dragon and defeat the enemy.
descripcion_corta: The sequel to the Ninku fighting adventure.
descripcion_larga: Ninku 2 expands the series with deeper story elements and more tactical combat. Explore a fantasy world and master the Ninku fighting styles in this polished Japanese exclusive.

objetivo: Win various challenges as the penguin Hiroyuki.
descripcion_corta: A quirky spin-off featuring the Ninku mascot.
descripcion_larga: Ninku Gaiden: Hiroyuki Daikatsugeki is a collection of fun and fast-paced mini-games. It captures the humor and art style of the series in a vibrant and accessible portable format.

nombre: Nomo Hideo no World Series Baseball (Japan)
objetivo: Lead your team to victory in the World Series.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive baseball sim featuring Hideo Nomo.
descripcion_larga: Nomo Hideo no World Series Baseball offers realistic 8-bit mechanics and professional stats. Celebrate the career of the legendary pitcher in this detailed and competitive sports title.

objetivo: Win the gold medal in the Barcelona '92 Games.
descripcion_corta: The refined v1.1 of the official Olympic game.
descripcion_larga: Olympic Gold (v1.1) features seven athletic events including 100m sprint and archery. With smooth animation and a high competitive curve, it’s one of the most polished sports titles for the Game Gear.

objetivo: Win the gold medal in the Barcelona '92 Games.
descripcion_corta: The worldwide release of the hit Olympic sim.
descripcion_larga: Experience the thrill of the 1994 Olympics on your handheld. Master the timing and button-mashing required to break world records in this comprehensive and officially licensed 8-bit sports collection.

objetivo: Find your family and avoid the hazards.
descripcion_corta: A charming European adventure based on the German comic.
descripcion_larga: The Ottifants features Bruno the elephant in a quest filled with puzzles and platforming. Its vibrant 8-bit graphics and creative level design make it a hidden gem for fans of character-driven platformers.

objetivo: Reach the finish line before time expires.
descripcion_corta: A faithful portable port of the legendary arcade racer.
descripcion_larga: Out Run (Japan) brings the blue skies and Ferrari Testarossa to the small screen. Featuring the iconic soundtrack and branching paths, it’s a high-speed nostalgia trip that looks great in color.

objetivo: Stop the criminal organization across Europe.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic spin-off with cars, boats, and bikes.
descripcion_larga: Out Run Europa shifts the focus to mission-based driving. Evade the police and take down enemies using various vehicles in this gritty and action-packed 8-bit expansion of the Out Run brand.

objetivo: Clear the screen of ghosts using Pac-Man.
descripcion_corta: A clever "Pac-themed" twist on the Tetris formula.
descripcion_larga: Pac-Attack combines classic puzzle mechanics with Pac-Man's ghost-eating hunger. Strategize your block placement to clear lines and unleash Pac-Man in this addictive and colorful handheld puzzler.

objetivo: Collect all items to open the door to the next level.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype of the clever puzzle-platformer.
descripcion_larga: Pac-In-Time (Proto) offers a rare look at a "lost" Game Gear title. Use different abilities like a rope or hammer to navigate levels in this unique 8-bit take on the Pac-Man universe.

objetivo: Eat all the dots and avoid the four ghosts.
descripcion_corta: A perfect, pocket-sized version of the arcade original.
descripcion_larga: Pac-Man on Game Gear is a faithful conversion of the 1980 legend. It features the classic maze and ghost AI, providing an endlessly replayable 8-bit arcade experience on the go.

objetivo: Destroy the enemy fleet while riding your dragon.
descripcion_corta: A rare handheld-exclusive entry in the Panzer series.
descripcion_larga: Panzer Dragoon Mini features "chibi" style dragons but maintains the series' intense shooting action. Dodge enemy fire and take down massive bosses in this unique and visually impressive Japanese exclusive.

objetivo: Deliver all newspapers while avoiding obstacles.
descripcion_corta: A frantic and challenging arcade conversion.
descripcion_larga: Paperboy brings the neighborhood chaos to your handheld. Navigate suburban streets filled with runaway tires, aggressive dogs, and breakable windows in this classic 8-bit test of reflexes.

objetivo: Deliver papers to new neighborhoods and avoid hazards.
descripcion_corta: The expanded sequel with more variety and characters.
descripcion_larga: Paperboy II features the choice of a paperboy or papergirl. With more obstacles and bonus levels, it expands the classic arcade formula for a deeper 8-bit portable challenge.

objetivo: Crush the Sno-Bees by sliding ice blocks.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the quirky Sega arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: Pengo features the brave penguin in a maze of ice. Use your environment to trap and defeat enemies in this vibrant and addictive 8-bit puzzle-actioner.

objetivo: Crush the Sno-Bees by sliding ice blocks.
descripcion_corta: The international release of the ice-block brawler.
descripcion_larga: Guide Pengo through 8-bit frozen mazes in this Western version. With its catchy music and fast-paced gameplay, it remains a cult classic for fans of old-school Sega arcade titles.

objetivo: Raise your dog and keep it healthy and happy.
descripcion_corta: A charming Japanese exclusive dog simulator.
descripcion_larga: Pet Club: Inu Daisuki! allows you to choose and care for various dog breeds. Feed, walk, and train your pet in this cute and colorful precursor to the modern virtual pet genre.

objetivo: Win the tournament and reach the top of the rankings.
descripcion_corta: A professional tennis sim endorsed by the legend.
descripcion_larga: Pete Sampras Tennis features fast-paced, fluid gameplay and multiple court types. Master the serve and volley to defeat tough AI opponents in this polished 8-bit sports title.

objetivo: Win the PGA Tour championship on pro courses.
descripcion_corta: The final and most refined 8-bit PGA simulation.
descripcion_larga: PGA Tour 96 offers updated stats and smooth 8-bit visuals. With its realistic approach to wind, club selection, and green reading, it’s a deep and rewarding portable golf experience.

objetivo: Win the PGA Tour championship on pro courses.
descripcion_corta: A foundational and realistic portable golf sim.
descripcion_larga: PGA Tour Golf brings the professional links to the Game Gear. Featuring real courses and a technical swing mechanic, it provides a high-quality sports challenge for golf fans on the go.

objetivo: Win the PGA Tour championship on pro courses.
descripcion_corta: Updated v1.1 release with refined mechanics.
descripcion_larga: This v1.1 of PGA Tour Golf features minor gameplay balance tweaks. Experience the pressure of the pro circuit with improved 8-bit physics and challenging course layouts.

objetivo: Compete in the tour with more courses and features.
descripcion_corta: The expansive sequel to the pro golf hit.
descripcion_larga: PGA Tour Golf II features more courses and improved graphics. It builds on the original's solid foundation to deliver one of the most comprehensive sports simulations on the Game Gear.

objetivo: Solve the mystery on the Motavia planet.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive adventure spin-off of the RPG saga.
descripcion_larga: Phantasy Star Adventure is a unique, text-heavy quest. Solve puzzles and interact with characters in the PS universe using an intuitive menu system in this rare and story-rich 8-bit title.

nombre: Phantasy Star Adventure (Japan) [En by Aeon Genesis v1.0]
objetivo: Solve the mystery on the Motavia planet.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the PS spin-off.
descripcion_larga: This English translation allows Western fans to finally play Phantasy Star Adventure. Experience the deep lore and character interactions of the Motavia mystery in full English on your handheld.

objetivo: Explore the world and stop the rising darkness.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive prequel to the original Phantasy Star.
descripcion_larga: Phantasy Star Gaiden features a new set of heroes and a traditional overhead perspective. It is an essential piece of lore for fans of the series, featuring classic 8-bit RPG combat and exploration.

nombre: Phantasy Star Gaiden (Japan) [En by Magic Destiny v1.012]
objetivo: Explore the world and stop the rising darkness.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the PS prequel.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation brings Phantasy Star Gaiden to the West. Embark on an epic 8-bit quest to uncover the origins of Alis and the star system in this deep and story-driven handheld RPG.

nombre: Phantasy Star Gaiden (Japan) [En by Magic Destiny v1.012] (Wide Font)
objetivo: Explore the world and stop the rising darkness.
descripcion_corta: English version with an improved, readable wide font.
descripcion_larga: This "Wide Font" version of Phantasy Star Gaiden (English) offers a more comfortable reading experience while exploring the game's massive story and tactical turn-based battles.

objetivo: Stop the conspiracy and save the city of the future.
descripcion_corta: A dark, atmospheric brawler based on the animated series.
descripcion_larga: Phantom 2040 features non-linear exploration and multiple endings. Use a variety of high-tech weapons to navigate a cyberpunk world in this visually stunning and deep 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Achieve the high score across multiple tables.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality port of the classic Amiga pinball hit.
descripcion_larga: Pinball Dreams features realistic physics and four distinct table themes: Ignition, Steel Wheel, Beat Box, and Nightmare. It’s one of the most mechanically sound pinball titles on the Game Gear.

objetivo: Defeat opponents in a game of professional Mahjong.
descripcion_corta: A portable and high-stakes Japanese Mahjong sim.
descripcion_larga: Pocket Jansou provides a deep challenge for Mahjong fans. With clear 8-bit tiles and multiple AI opponents, it’s a solid and strategic title designed for long gaming sessions on the go.

objetivo: Win big at the Blackjack table.
descripcion_corta: A specialized part of the "Poker Faced Paul" collection.
descripcion_larga: Poker Faced Paul's Blackjack offers a realistic 8-bit casino experience. Master your betting strategy and try to beat the dealer in this clean and accessible handheld card simulation.

objetivo: Outscore your opponent in a game of Gin Rummy.
descripcion_corta: A portable and competitive card game sim.
descripcion_larga: Poker Faced Paul's Gin brings the classic card game to the Game Gear. Featuring smart AI and clear visuals, it’s a perfect title for those looking for a strategic and relaxing handheld experience.

objetivo: Win the tournament in a high-stakes Poker match.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive and challenging portable Poker sim.
descripcion_larga: Poker Faced Paul's Poker features various styles and betting modes. Test your bluffing skills against the computer in this detailed and well-presented 8-bit card simulation.

objetivo: Clear the board in several Solitaire variations.
descripcion_corta: The ultimate portable Solitaire collection.
descripcion_larga: Poker Faced Paul's Solitaire features multiple modes including Klondike and Spider. It’s the perfect "pick-up-and-play" title for the Game Gear, offering relaxing and addictive puzzle-card fun.

objetivo: Clear the screen by matching colored balls.
descripcion_corta: A vibrant Japanese exclusive color-matching puzzler.
descripcion_larga: Pop Breaker is a high-energy puzzle game for the Game Gear. Featuring cute characters and fast-paced gameplay, you must strategically clear the board in this colorful 8-bit handheld gem.

objetivo: Win the beach volleyball tournament as Popeye.
descripcion_corta: A sun-soaked sports title starring the famous sailor.
descripcion_larga: Popeye no Beach Volleyball (Japan) features fun, arcade-style sports action. Master your serves and spikes on the sand in this charming and visually bright Japanese exclusive.

objetivo: Destroy the sky pirates and their mechanical fleet.
descripcion_corta: One of the most technically impressive 8-bit shooters.
descripcion_larga: Power Strike II (GG Aleste II) is a masterpiece by Compile. Featuring blistering speed, incredible weapon variety, and massive bosses, it is a must-play technical showcase for the system.

objetivo: Rescue hostages and defeat the Predator in the city.
descripcion_corta: A gritty urban shooter based on the sci-fi sequel.
descripcion_larga: Predator 2 tasks you with navigating dangerous city streets while being hunted. Use a variety of high-tech weapons to clear drug gangs and survive the ultimate hunter in this intense 8-bit title.

objetivo: Defeat the other beast-gods to rule Urth.
descripcion_corta: A portable version of the prehistoric fighting hit.
descripcion_larga: Primal Rage brings giant dinosaur combat to your pocket. Featuring digitized-style sprites and special moves, it captures the unique dark atmosphere of the arcade original on 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Rescue the Princess within the 60-minute time limit.
descripcion_corta: A smooth and cinematic puzzle-platformer classic.
descripcion_larga: Prince of Persia on Game Gear features incredibly fluid rotoscoped animation. Navigate deadly traps and engage in sword duels in this faithful and challenging 8-bit conversion.

objetivo: Rescue the Princess within the 60-minute time limit.
descripcion_corta: Beta version of the cinematic platforming epic.
descripcion_larga: This Prince of Persia Beta offers a rare look at the development of the 8-bit port. Test the physics and the iconic timer-based gameplay in this early handheld build.

objetivo: Lead your team to the Japanese championship.
descripcion_corta: A detailed 1991 Japanese professional baseball sim.
descripcion_larga: The Pro Yakyuu '91 offers deep stats and realistic 8-bit mechanics. Experience the high-stakes world of Japanese pro baseball with smooth pitching and batting gameplay.

objetivo: Win the league title with updated 1994 rosters.
descripcion_corta: Refined and fast-paced Japanese baseball action.
descripcion_larga: Pro Yakyuu GG League '94 features improved graphics and tighter controls. It’s a solid and competitive sports simulation that shines on the Game Gear’s color screen.

objetivo: Win the league title with the pro Japanese teams.
descripcion_corta: The foundational entry in the GG League series.
descripcion_larga: Pro Yakyuu GG League brings arcade-style baseball to the handheld. With its accessible controls and vibrant sprites, it’s a perfect "pick-up-and-play" sports title for the move.

objetivo: Rescue your friend using ESP and psychic powers.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality action game with RPG elements.
descripcion_larga: Psychic World features Lucia, a heroine who uses different elemental psychic shots. Navigate through beautifully drawn levels and upgrade your powers in this polished 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Rescue your friend using ESP and psychic powers.
descripcion_corta: Updated v1.1 of the psychic-powered adventure.
descripcion_larga: Experience refined gameplay in Psychic World (v1.1). This version features minor tweaks to the difficulty and mechanics, making it the definitive way to play this 8-bit classic.

objetivo: Sink the ball in the hole while avoiding hazards.
descripcion_corta: A quirky and colorful golf-puzzle hybrid.
descripcion_larga: Putt & Putter (Japan) features creative courses and tricky obstacles. It’s a fun and strategic take on mini-golf that rewards precision and planning on the 8-bit screen.

objetivo: Sink the ball in the hole while avoiding hazards.
descripcion_corta: The international release of the golf-puzzle hit.
descripcion_larga: Challenge yourself with the clever level design of Putt & Putter. This version offers addictive "puzzle-golf" gameplay that is perfect for short portable sessions.

objetivo: Match four "Puyos" of the same color to clear them.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese block-matching sensation.
descripcion_larga: Puyo Puyo on Game Gear is an addictive test of speed and logic. Chain together massive combos to bury your opponent in "garbage" in this quintessential 8-bit puzzle classic.

objetivo: Defeat rivals in the tower to become the champion.
descripcion_corta: The expanded sequel with new characters and modes.
descripcion_larga: Puyo Puyo 2 (Puyo Puyo Tsu) adds the "Offsetting" mechanic, deepening the strategy. Featuring vibrant art and voice clips, it is one of the best puzzle games on the system.

objetivo: Complete a series of wacky challenges to win.
descripcion_corta: A portable version of the iconic puzzle-arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: Tanto-R features dozens of hilarious and fast-paced mini-games. Test your reflexes, memory, and logic in this vibrant Japanese exclusive that perfectly captures Sega’s quirky spirit.

objetivo: Clear the screen by matching three or more bubbles.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the addictive puzzle hit.
descripcion_larga: Puzzle Bobble brings the color-matching sensation to your pocket. Aim your launcher and clear the board in this high-pressure, endlessly replayable 8-bit puzzle classic.

nombre: Quest for the Shaven Yak Starring Ren Hoek & Stimpy (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Find the legendary Shaven Yak with the Nick duo.
descripcion_corta: A wacky and gross-out Looney adventure.
descripcion_larga: Quest for the Shaven Yak features the iconic humor of Ren & Stimpy. Navigate bizarre levels and use your unique abilities in this colorful and challenging 8-bit platformer.

objetivo: Defeat enemies by answering trivia questions.
descripcion_corta: A unique Japanese hybrid of quiz and combat.
descripcion_larga: The Quiz Gear Fight!! tasks you with using your knowledge to win battles. It’s a charming and visually distinct title that offers a refreshing twist on the 8-bit fighting genre.

objetivo: Win the World Series with professional rosters.
descripcion_corta: A fast and accessible portable baseball sim.
descripcion_larga: R.B.I. Baseball '94 features officially licensed players and authentic stats. With its smooth animation and strategic depth, it’s a top-tier sports experience for Game Gear.

objetivo: Win races and upgrade your car to the top tier.
descripcion_corta: A challenging and high-speed overhead racer.
descripcion_larga: R.C. Grand Prix features a unique perspective and deep car customization. Master the tight corners and manage your budget in this technically impressive 8-bit racing sim.

objetivo: Defeat the dragon and rescue the princess.
descripcion_corta: A dark and atmospheric barbarian brawler.
descripcion_larga: Rastan Saga (Japan) brings the arcade's gritty combat to the handheld. Use your sword and various items to battle mythical beasts in this difficult and visually moody 8-bit classic.

objetivo: Rescue Minnie Mouse from the witch Mizrabel.
descripcion_corta: The North American name for Castle of Illusion.
descripcion_larga: Revenge of Drancon is the same legendary Mickey Mouse adventure under a different title. Experience the pinnacle of 8-bit platforming with stunning graphics and perfect controls.

objetivo: Knock out rivals to become the world champion.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the pro-boxing sim.
descripcion_larga: Riddick Bowe Boxing features large, detailed sprites and an intense behind-the-back perspective. Master your defense and power punches to climb the rankings in this 8-bit title.

objetivo: Knock out rivals to become the world champion.
descripcion_corta: A gritty and hard-hitting 8-bit boxing sim.
