descripcion_larga: Experience the intensity of the ring with Riddick Bowe. Featuring a deep career mode and smooth animation, it’s one of the most mechanically sound boxing games on the handheld.

objetivo: Win the tournament to save the future.
descripcion_corta: A futuristic fighter with high-tech robots.
descripcion_larga: Rise of the Robots features impressive pre-rendered style sprites for the time. Battle through a series of metallic rivals in this visually unique and atmospheric 8-bit brawler.

objetivo: Save the solar system by grabbing and throwing.
descripcion_corta: A visual and mechanical masterpiece for Game Gear.
descripcion_larga: Ristar is one of the best games on the system. Instead of jumping, use Ristar’s extendable arms to climb, swing, and headbutt enemies in this incredibly colorful and creative 8-bit quest.

objetivo: Win illegal bike races and outrun the cops.
descripcion_corta: A fast, fluid, and violent motorcycle racer.
descripcion_larga: Road Rash on Game Gear is a technical marvel. Punch and kick your rivals at high speeds while navigating traffic in this incredibly addictive and responsive 8-bit arcade port.

objetivo: Protect the innocent and stop OCP's corruption.
descripcion_corta: A gritty action game based on the sci-fi sequel.
descripcion_larga: RoboCop 3 features multiple gameplay styles, including side-scrolling combat and flying sequences. Use your high-tech weaponry to bring justice to a dark 8-bit Detroit.

objetivo: Prevent the future where Skynet rules the world.
descripcion_corta: A gritty crossover with intense 8-bit firepower.
descripcion_larga: RoboCop versus The Terminator delivers explosive action. Fight through waves of Terminators and corrupt OCP forces in this visually dark and challenging handheld shooter based on the comic series.

objetivo: Defeat the Robot Masters as Roll.
descripcion_corta: A charming fan-made "hack" of Mega Man.
descripcion_larga: Roll-chan: Mini World swaps the iconic hero for his sister, Roll. Experience the tight platforming and boss battles of the original Game Gear Mega Man with a fresh, adorable character skin.

nombre: Royal Stone - Hirakareshi Toki no Tobira (Japan)
objetivo: Lead Eva on a quest to restore her honor and kingdom.
descripcion_corta: One of the most beautiful and deep RPGs on the system.
descripcion_larga: Royal Stone is a technical marvel featuring large, detailed combat sprites and a deep tactical system. It’s the spiritual successor to Crystal Warriors, offering a mature story and polished 8-bit strategy.

objetivo: Clear the board by matching traditional tiles.
descripcion_corta: A relaxing and strategic Japanese puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Ryuukyuu brings the atmosphere of traditional tile games to the Game Gear. Use logic and foresight to clear the screen in this culturally rich and addictive 8-bit handheld experience.

objetivo: Save the passengers from the sinking ocean liner.
descripcion_corta: A unique rescue-based platformer.
descripcion_larga: S.S. Lucifer: Man Overboard! (known as Sink or Swim elsewhere) tasks you with clearing paths and operating machinery to guide survivors to safety in this clever and colorful 8-bit puzzle game.

objetivo: Win the tournament using ancient weapon arts.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality port of SNK's weapon-based fighter.
descripcion_larga: Samurai Shodown features the iconic cast, including Haohmaru and Nakoruru. Experience the tension of blade-to-blade combat and powerful special moves in this impressive 8-bit conversion.

objetivo: Win the tournament using ancient weapon arts.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the SNK brawler.
descripcion_larga: Samurai Spirits (Japan) captures the arcade's style with large character portraits and fluid 1v1 combat. It remains one of the most mechanically sound fighting games on the Game Gear.

objetivo: Win the tournament and improve your handicap.
descripcion_corta: A precise and detailed Japanese golf sim.
descripcion_larga: Scratch Golf features realistic physics and a variety of courses. Manage your club selection and account for the elements in this polished and relaxing 8-bit sports title.

objetivo: Command mobile suits to win the interstellar war.
descripcion_corta: A deep tactical Gundam sim with beautiful art.
descripcion_larga: SD Gundam: Winner's History features iconic mechs in strategic grid-based battles. Utilize different units and terrain to defeat the enemy forces in this polished Japanese exclusive.

nombre: SD Gundam - Winner's History (Japan) [En by Gaijin v0.99]
objetivo: Command mobile suits to win the interstellar war.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the Gundam sim.
descripcion_larga: This English version of Winner's History allows fans to fully understand the deep tactical menus and story of the SD Gundam universe on the Game Gear’s color screen.

objetivo: High scores in Columns, Soccer, Rally, and Tennis.
descripcion_corta: A diverse 4-in-1 bundle for quick gaming bursts.
descripcion_larga: Sega Game Pack features four classic genres in one cartridge. Whether you want a quick puzzle or a sports match, it’s the ultimate "pick-up-and-play" companion for the portable system.

objetivo: Lead your team to victory in a global tournament.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced and fluid 8-bit soccer classic.
descripcion_larga: Sensible Soccer features the series' signature zoomed-out view and lightning-fast controls. Master the curve-shot and lead your favorite club to glory in this highly-regarded portable sim.

objetivo: Travel across the desert to reclaim the kingdom.
descripcion_corta: An Arabian-themed RPG with beautiful visuals.
descripcion_larga: Shadam Crusader (known as Defenders of Oasis in the West) is a storytelling masterpiece. Explore ancient ruins and engage in tactical battles in this visually stunning 8-bit handheld quest.

objetivo: Match tiles to clear the board within the time limit.
descripcion_corta: A polished portable version of the classic Shanghai.
descripcion_larga: Shanghai II features multiple tile sets and challenging layouts. It’s a perfect test of observation and logic that shines on the Game Gear’s high-contrast color screen.

objetivo: Rescue a boy and defeat the evil Kaile.
descripcion_corta: A martial arts fighter starring the basketball legend.
descripcion_larga: Shaq Fu features large, fluidly animated sprites and a unique mystical setting. Battle through a variety of supernatural opponents in this colorful and quirky 8-bit handheld brawler.

objetivo: Move the blocks to clear the path and escape.
descripcion_corta: A brain-teasing Japanese logic puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Shikinjou tasks you with manipulating tiles within a confined space. It’s a challenging and addictive title that rewards patience and planning, perfect for the dedicated puzzle gamer.

nombre: Shining Force Gaiden - Ensei, Jashin no Kuni e (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the forces of Iom and save the kingdom.
descripcion_corta: The first portable entry in the legendary saga.
descripcion_larga: Shining Force Gaiden features the series' iconic turn-based grid combat and cinematic battle animations. Lead your army through a deep story in this essential 8-bit strategy classic.

objetivo: Stop the resurrection of the ancient evil.
descripcion_corta: The epic conclusion to the Game Gear Gaiden trilogy.
descripcion_larga: Final Conflict bridges the story between the first and second main games. It features refined mechanics and some of the best 8-bit tactical combat ever produced for a handheld.

nombre: Shining Force Gaiden - Final Conflict (Japan) [En by SFCentral v20060707]
objetivo: Stop the resurrection of the ancient evil.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated finale of the Gaiden trilogy.
descripcion_larga: This English version of Final Conflict allows Western fans to experience the lore-heavy conclusion of the saga. Engage in massive tactical battles and follow the story in full English.

nombre: Shining Force Gaiden II - Jashin no Kakusei (Japan)
objetivo: Assemble the Shining Force to stop the god of evil.
descripcion_corta: The acclaimed sequel to the first portable Gaiden.
descripcion_larga: Shining Force Gaiden II (The Sword of Hajya) features an expanded roster and more complex battle scenarios. It is widely considered one of the finest strategy games in the 8-bit era.

nombre: Shining Force II - The Sword of Hajya (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Assemble the Shining Force to stop the god of evil.
descripcion_corta: The international release of the strategy masterpiece.
descripcion_larga: Shining Force II: The Sword of Hajya brings the epic console experience to your pocket. Master tactical positioning and level up your heroes in this definitive handheld RPG adventure.

objetivo: Clear the table and win the billiards tournament.
descripcion_corta: A stylish and realistic 8-bit pool simulation.
descripcion_larga: Side Pocket features smooth ball physics and a cool jazz-inspired atmosphere. Master trick shots and compete in various modes in this polished and addictive handheld sports title.

nombre: Simpsons, The - Bart vs. The Space Mutants (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Stop the aliens from spray-painting the world purple.
descripcion_corta: A creative Simpsons adventure with unique mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Bart vs. The Space Mutants tasks you with using gadgets to reveal hidden aliens. It’s a challenging and visually vibrant movie/TV tie-in with a focus on exploration and puzzles.

nombre: Simpsons, The - Bart vs. The World (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Rescue the Simpsons family from a global tour.
descripcion_corta: A massive world-spanning Simpsons adventure.
descripcion_larga: Bart vs. The World features varied mini-games and platforming levels across the globe. Use Bart’s costumes and skills to defeat Krusty’s rivals in this colorful 8-bit quest.

objetivo: Paint the floor of each level to move forward.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced and colorful Japanese puzzle port.
descripcion_larga: Skweek features a cute hero in a quest to recolor the world. Dodge enemies and manage power-ups in this addictive and visually bright 8-bit handheld arcade title.

objetivo: Slide the tiles to guide the light to the exit.
descripcion_corta: A challenging and unique light-based logic game.
descripcion_larga: Slider (known as Skweek in Europe) requires fast thinking and precise movement. Navigate hazard-filled floors to clear each level in this polished and creative 8-bit puzzler.

objetivo: Rescue the captured Smurfs from Gargamel.
descripcion_corta: A beautiful and difficult European platformer.
descripcion_larga: The Smurfs features vibrant graphics that perfectly capture the cartoon’s art style. Navigate through forests and caves in this high-quality and challenging 8-bit handheld adventure.

objetivo: Play several variations of the classic Solitaire.
descripcion_corta: The ultimate card game companion for Game Gear.
descripcion_larga: Solitaire Funpak offers a variety of modes including Klondike and FreeCell. With its clean interface and portable nature, it’s the perfect title for a relaxing gaming session on the go.

objetivo: Combine Solitaire and Poker into a unique challenge.
descripcion_corta: A creative hybrid of two classic card genres.
descripcion_larga: Solitaire Poker tasks you with building poker hands within a solitaire layout. It’s a deep and strategic title that provides a fresh twist on traditional 8-bit handheld card games.

objetivo: Save the animals and find the Chaos Emeralds.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Sonic Chaos.
descripcion_larga: Sonic & Tails features two playable characters with unique moves. Fly with Tails or speed through levels with Sonic in this vibrant and high-speed 8-bit handheld exclusive.

objetivo: Defeat Dr. Robotnik and his robotic army.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Sonic the Hedgehog Triple Trouble.
descripcion_larga: Sonic & Tails 2 features large sprites and impressive vehicle segments. It is one of the most technically advanced Sonic titles on the Game Gear, offering pure 8-bit speed and color.

objetivo: Stop Dr. Robotnik and find the Chaos Emeralds.
descripcion_corta: A visually unique Sonic with pre-rendered graphics.
descripcion_larga: Sonic Blast pushes the Game Gear's limits with its pseudo-3D look. Play as Sonic or Knuckles and blast through colorful zones in this late-release handheld adventure that offers a distinct 8-bit visual style.

descripcion_corta: The first 8-bit Sonic game featuring Tails as playable.
descripcion_larga: Sonic Chaos delivers high-speed action and creative level design. Use Tails’ flight or Sonic’s new Strike Dash to navigate vibrant zones in this highly-regarded 8-bit portable classic.

objetivo: Win the Grand Prix and outpace your rivals.
descripcion_corta: The first-ever Sonic kart racing experience.

descripcion_corta: A rare "Sample" or demo build of the racing hit.
descripcion_larga: This Sonic Drift (Sample) offers a fascinating look at the game's pre-release state. Experience the core racing mechanics and 8-bit scaling tech that defined Sonic’s first handheld kart outing.

objetivo: Become the champion of the Blue, Yellow, and Red GPs.
descripcion_corta: The expanded and refined handheld racing sequel.
descripcion_larga: Sonic Drift 2 features more characters, including Metal Sonic and Knuckles. With improved handling and more diverse tracks, it’s the definitive 8-bit kart racer for the Game Gear.

objetivo: Navigate the mazes and find the exit keys.
descripcion_corta: A unique and challenging "spin" on Sonic gameplay.

objetivo: Free the animals and stop the Veg-O-Fortress.
descripcion_corta: A high-energy pinball adventure starring Sonic.
descripcion_larga: Sonic Spinball brings the 16-bit hit to your pocket. Navigate massive 8-bit pinball tables as Sonic, using momentum and flippers to defeat bosses in this intense and unique platformer.

nombre: Sonic The Hedgehog - Triple Trouble (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Stop Robotnik and Knuckles from taking the emeralds.
descripcion_corta: Widely considered the best Sonic game on the system.
descripcion_larga: Sonic The Hedgehog: Triple Trouble is a technical masterpiece. Featuring large zones, vehicle segments, and incredible boss fights, it’s the pinnacle of 8-bit Sonic platforming.

objetivo: Save the animals and defeat Dr. Robotnik.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of Sonic's portable debut.
descripcion_larga: Sonic The Hedgehog (Japan) offers a unique set of levels distinct from the Genesis version. Explore the Bridge and Jungle Zones in this vibrant and perfectly-scaled 8-bit classic.

objetivo: Save the animals and defeat Dr. Robotnik.
descripcion_corta: A rare prototype of the original 8-bit Sonic.

objetivo: Save the animals and defeat Dr. Robotnik.
descripcion_corta: The refined v1.1 release of the 8-bit debut.

objetivo: Rescue Tails from the clutches of Dr. Robotnik.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult and high-speed sequel.

objetivo: Destroy the dragon invaders and save the world.
descripcion_corta: A stunning and fluid port of the arcade legend.

nombre: Spider-Man - Return of the Sinister Six (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Defeat the Six and stop Mysterio's sinister plan.
descripcion_corta: A gritty and challenging Spider-Man adventure.

nombre: Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Revenge (USA, Europe)

objetivo: Stop the Kingpin and defuse the city's bomb.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic brawler based on the hit comic/show.
descripcion_larga: Spider-Man vs. The Kingpin features branching paths and intense boss battles. Use Spidey's agility to navigate through New York and defeat the criminal underworld in this polished 8-bit title.

objetivo: Find Fantasio and stop the evil plot.

nombre: Sports Illustrated Championship Football & Baseball (USA, Europe)

nombre: Star Trek - The Next Generation (USA, Europe)

descripcion_larga: WWF Raw features iconic superstars like Undertaker and Bret Hart. Master a variety of moves and signature finishers in this high-energy handheld brawler with multiple match types.

objetivo: Escape the cage or pin your opponent to win.
descripcion_corta: A unique steel cage wrestling experience.
descripcion_larga: Wrestlemania Steel Cage Challenge brings the intensity of the squared circle to the Game Gear. Use the cage to your advantage in this tactical and action-packed European exclusive.

objetivo: Stop the Gamemaster and save the captured X-Men.
descripcion_corta: A deep and challenging Marvel superhero quest.
descripcion_larga: Gamemaster's Legacy features multiple playable X-Men with unique powers. Switch between heroes to navigate complex levels and defeat iconic villains in this polished 8-bit adventure.

objetivo: Escape Mojo World and defeat the spineless One.
descripcion_corta: A vibrant and difficult X-Men adventure.
descripcion_larga: X-Men: Mojo World lets you control Wolverine and Rogue in a fight for survival. Use mutant abilities to solve environmental puzzles and battle bosses in this visually impressive 8-bit title.

objetivo: Defeat Magneto and his army of mutants.
descripcion_corta: The debut of the X-Men on Sega's handheld.
descripcion_larga: Experience the power of the X-Men on the go. Featuring Storm, Wolverine, and Cyclops, this action-packed title delivers intense platforming and combat across iconic Marvel locations.

nombre: Yogi Bear in Yogi Bear's Goldrush (Proto)
objetivo: Collect the gold and avoid the park rangers.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype starring the famous bear.
descripcion_larga: Yogi Bear's Goldrush (Proto) offers a rare look at a lost handheld title. Explore Jellystone Park in this colorful and family-friendly 8-bit platformer with classic mascot gameplay.

nombre: Yu Yu Hakusho - Horobishimono no Gyakushuu (Japan)
objetivo: Win the tournament using spiritual powers.
descripcion_corta: A high-energy fighter based on the hit anime.
descripcion_larga: Yu Yu Hakusho features large sprites and fluid combat. Use Yusuke's Spirit Gun and other signature moves to defeat powerful rivals in this technically impressive Japanese exclusive.

nombre: Yu Yu Hakusho 2 - Gekitou! Nanakyou no Tatakai (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the seven powerful rivals in combat.
descripcion_corta: The refined and faster sequel to the anime fighter.
descripcion_larga: Yu Yu Hakusho 2 improves on everything from the first game, featuring a larger roster and more special moves. It is one of the best-looking and best-playing 1v1 brawlers on the system.

nombre: Yu Yu Hakusho 2 - Gekitou! Nanakyou no Tatakai (Japan) [En by Gaijin v1.0]
objetivo: Defeat the seven powerful rivals in combat.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the anime sequel.
descripcion_larga: This localized version of Yu Yu Hakusho 2 allows Western fans to understand the story and move lists of this incredible handheld fighter, making the deep combat mechanics fully accessible.

objetivo: Command your units to conquer the enemy territory.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive futuristic military sim.
descripcion_larga: Zan Gear features tactical grid-based combat with a variety of land and air units. It’s a deep and rewarding strategy title that rewards patience and careful planning on the 8-bit screen.

objetivo: Save the Nth dimension from the alien invaders.
descripcion_corta: A fast and fluid port of the ninja-gremlin hit.
descripcion_larga: Zool features lightning-fast gameplay and vibrant, candy-themed levels. Use your ninja skills to climb and shoot through this high-energy and challenging 8-bit arcade conversion.

objetivo: Save the Nth dimension from the alien invaders.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese release of the Zool adventure.
descripcion_larga: Zool no Yume Bouken (Zool's Dream Adventure) brings the cult-classic mascot to the Game Gear with smooth animation and catchy 8-bit music. It’s a technical showcase for the handheld's speed.

objetivo: Shoot shapes from the center to clear the edges.
descripcion_corta: A frantic and colorful European-exclusive puzzler.
descripcion_larga: Zoop (Europe) is a game of quick reflexes and spatial logic. Clear the encroaching tiles before they reach the center in this addictive and unique 8-bit handheld puzzle experience.

objetivo: Shoot shapes from the center to clear the edges.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the puzzle sensation.
descripcion_larga: Experience the "America's Largest Puzzle Game" on your Game Gear. Zoop offers endless replayability and increasing difficulty, making it a perfect title for short bursts of portable play.
